ModMetaData.name: Full Armor - Hands and Feet [1.6]
ModMetaData.author: Mylapqn
ModMetaData.description:
Tired of your pawns in full marine armor losing fingers constantly? This is the solution!
Full Armor - Hands and Feet is and advanced auto-patcher that extends armor coverage to the hands and feet.
Allows detailed control over which apparel the patch extends to.
Supports 1.6 and Odyssey as well as modded armor. Compatibility fix with gloves/shoes mods included.
